description: WHEN TO USE: To get a list of all brand monitoring projects for the current user. Use as the FIRST step to discover available projects before working with scans or results. RETURNS: Compact CSV with id, brand_name, status, visibility_pct, models_count, prompts_count (default). Set include_all_fields=true for full JSON. NEXT STEP: Use lbm_get_project with a specific project id for full details.

include_all_fields.description: Set true for full JSON response. Default: false (compact CSV — recommended).

status.description: Optional: filter by status (active, inactive, pending)

name: lbm_list_projects
